title: Nice paw patrol items.  Not a good value.
text: Nice paw patrol items.  Not a good value.. Paw Patrol is the hooplah of all things for pre-schoolers!  The stands are sturdy cardboard, not reusable unless you are very careful.  The treats included to put on top of the cake are hard sugar candies, shaped like paws.  The cupcake liners have paw-patrol prints on them.  The other cupcake decorations are cute.  The reason for 3 stars is because of the value.  I don't think this kit is worth $30.  I would have to price it no more than $20.  But, if you kid really has to have paw-patrol, you'll probably spend this on individual items, so either way, you little one will be happy.

description: All the makings of a fun paw Patrol birthday party are right here.
